meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会对指定代码做深度安全审计:跑 OWASP Top 10 检查、扫硬编码密钥、查依赖漏洞,把发现和 APPROVED / CHANGES REQUIRED 结论写进 docs/reviews/ 报告。
howto.when: 当你在发布前、改动涉及认证/授权/数据处理之后、新增依赖等时机,或直接要求做安全审计时接管;未指定范围则默认审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.text: 扫描整个 src/ 目录里的硬编码密钥
say.note: 列出发现的密钥及位置

say.text: 检查依赖里有没有已知 CVE 漏洞

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a deep security audit on the given code: OWASP Top 10 checks, hardcoded-secret scanning, dependency CVE review, then writes findings and an APPROVED / CHANGES REQUIRED verdict to docs/reviews/.
howto.when_en: Use it before a release, after changes touching authentication, authorization or data handling, when adding dependencies, or when you ask for a security audit. With no scope given, the whole src/ directory is audited.

say_en.text: Scan the whole src/ directory for hardcoded secrets
say_en.note: Lists secrets found and their locations

say_en.text: Check dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities
